_comment: Reviewed exceptions for links that cannot be automatically checked. Each exception must be per-card with specific verification note.

7run3-running-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names 7Run3 Running Club and describes area code 713 Houston training club for all distances 5K to ultra, Memorial Park meetings.

anchor-leg-athletic-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Anchor Leg Athletic Club, volunteer running/cycling club meeting Thursdays at Devil and the Deep Brewery in Galveston.

bayou-city-road-runners.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Bayou City Road Runners, social/performance club with long Houston history, weekly runs at Rice and Memorial Park.

cypress-running-club.note: Dedicated club site (Cypress Running Crew); homepage names the club, community-based nonprofit serving Cypress/NW Houston, Saturday runs at Sampson Elementary.

fass-run-club.note: Brewery events page. Verified page mentions Fass Run Club as Conroe's only running and beer club, open to all skill levels. No deeper club page found.

ffp-running-clubs.note: Organization homepage for FFP Running Clubs network; names FFP and describes free community-based clubs throughout Houston, multiple locations listed.

no-label-running-club.note: FFP organization homepage listing multiple clubs including No Label Running Club. No dedicated page for No Label club found on FFP site.

ffp-running-clubs.note: Organization homepage for FFP Running Clubs network (www redirects to non-www); names FFP and describes free community-based clubs throughout Houston, multiple locations listed.

no-label-running-club.note: FFP organization homepage listing multiple clubs including No Label Running Club (www redirects to non-www). No dedicated page for No Label club found on FFP site.

freaks-come-out-at-night-run-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Freaks Come Out at Night Run Club, 501(c)(3) nonprofit meeting Fridays 7:15pm at rotating Houston venues.

galveston-running-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Galveston Running Club, Galveston Island club promoting running community and healthy living through group runs.

good-guys-run-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Good Guys Run Club, community-led club meeting Wednesdays 7pm along MKT Heritage Trail and Heights Highline.

good-times-running-co-run-club.note: Running store homepage; mentions community run club with Tuesday evening and Saturday morning runs. Katy locally owned specialty store. No deeper club page found.

hardloop-endurance.note: Dedicated club/coaching site; homepage names Hardloop Endurance, specializes in custom training plans and coaching for endurance runners in Katy.

holler-haulers-run-club.note: Brewery homepage; site mentions Holler Haulers run club meeting Wednesday 6:30pm with 3-mile or 5-mile options. No dedicated club page found.

houston-area-trail-runners.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Houston Area Trail Runners (HATS), specifically for trail running in Houston area, supports local ultra/trail community.

houston-fit.note: Training program homepage; names Houston Fit, large training program for runners of all abilities aiming for marathons/half marathons, multiple locations.

houston-harriers.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Houston Harriers, competitive running club open to all ages/paces, re-organized 2017, 47 USA National Titles.

houston-hash-house-harriers.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Houston Hash House Harriers, social group calling itself a drinking club with a running problem.

houston-striders.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Houston Striders, friendly and inclusive club accommodating all paces and abilities at Memorial Park.

in-flight-running.note: Coaching/apparel shop homepage (redirects to shop.inflightrunning.com); mentions In Flight Running offers professional coaching and structured training programs for all levels. No deeper club page found.

katy-area-running-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Katy Area Running Club (KARC), only 501(c)(3) nonprofit running club in Katy serving all ages/abilities.

pasadena-texas-running-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Pasadena Texas Running Club, HARRA-affiliated club fostering supportive running community in Pasadena area.

pearland-area-road-runners.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Pearland Area Road Runners, community club serving Pearland helping runners find community and improve.

power-in-motion.note: Training program homepage; names Power In Motion (PIM), 10-week adult 5K clinic for new/intermediate runners held twice yearly at Memorial Park.

rise-runners-walkers.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names RISE Runners & Walkers, free 501(c)(3) run/walk club in Sugar Land providing support and encouragement.

team-green-running.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Team Green Running, year-round 501(c)(3) developmental/competitive club in The Woodlands coaching youth through masters.

texas-storm-track-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Texas Storm Track Club, member-based track/field club serving Pearland area with training programs and events.

texas-trackstars.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Texas TrackStars (capital S), building speed/endurance/confidence for 30+ years in Richmond TX.

vallensons-run-club.note: Brewery homepage; site mentions weekly runs starting/ending at Vallensons' Brewing Company in Pearland. No dedicated club page found.

bay-area-running-club.note: Site has intermittent TLS errors. Verified in browser: loads correctly, shows Bay Area Running Club homepage with club history (founded 1975), member benefits, and Space City 10 Miler info. Official club site.

black-men-run-houston.note: Returns 403 (bot protection). Verified via web search and curl with browser UA: page exists, shows Houston chapter info with Facebook group link and Instagram handle. Official chapter page.

atascocita-titans-track-club.note: Instagram page gets rate-limited. Verified page exists and is active (Atascocita Titans Track Club Humble/Atascocita area). No official website found after searching org site and registration platforms.

citycentre-running-club.note: Facebook page may get rate-limited. Verified page exists: CityCentre Running Club, FFP affiliate, meets Monday 5:30pm at CityCentre. No dedicated website found.

west-end-running-club.note: Facebook page may get rate-limited. Verified page exists: West End Running Club, FFP affiliate on Washington Ave. No dedicated website found.

westchase-district-run-club.note: Facebook page may get rate-limited. Verified page exists: Westchase District Run Club, FFP affiliate, meets Wednesdays at Camden Park. No dedicated website found.

northwest-flyers-track-club.note: TLS certificate verification errors. Verified in browser with security exception: site loads, shows Northwest Flyers Track Club info, training locations (Tomball/Spring), meet schedule. Official club site.

runners-high-club.note: TLS certificate verification errors. Verified in browser with security exception: site loads, shows Runner's High Club info, Memorial Park training program since 1997, marathon/half schedules. Official club site.

the-gooses-acre-run-club.note: Returns 403 (bot protection). Verified via web search: The Goose's Acre pub in The Woodlands hosts weekly running club. This is the run club page URL.

njord-running.note: Dedicated run crew page on apparel brand site; names Njörd Run Crew, service through sport mission, meets Wednesdays at Northside High School track and Saturdays at Active Passion.

tornados-running-club.note: Dedicated club site; homepage names Tornados Running Club, 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded 1988, history page, training info, year-round marathon/half training.

the-woodlands-running-club.note: Site can be slow to respond (occasional timeouts). Verified: loads correctly, shows The Woodlands Running Club homepage with programs (track workouts, long runs, trail, Juniors). Official club site.

samuel-aramco-half-course-record-2026.note: Houston Chronicle article behind paywall. Verified URL format correct, article about Habtom Samuel's Aramco Houston Half course record exists.

houston-marathon-2026-road-closures.note: Houston Chronicle article behind paywall. Verified URL format correct, article about 2026 Houston Marathon road closures guide exists.
